code: import{useState,useCallback}from'react';import{ollamaService}from'../services/ollamaService';export const useOllama=()=>{const[loading,setLoading]=useState(false);const[error,setError]=useState(null);const[isConnected,setIsConnected]=useState(false);const checkConnection=useCallback(async()=>{const connected=await ollamaService.healthCheck();setIsConnected(connected);return connected;},[]);const sendMessage=useCallback(async function(message,context){let options=arguments.length>2&&arguments[2]!==undefined?arguments[2]:{};setLoading(true);setError(null);try{const response=await ollamaService.sendMessage(message,context,options);setLoading(false);return response;}catch(err){setError(err.message);setLoading(false);throw err;}},[]);return{sendMessage,loading,error,isConnected,checkConnection};};
